about: Get a certificate for a marriage, medical or study matter abroad, issued to a UAE national. For UAE nationals only.
note: Requirements read from the official MOFA service page on the checked date. MOFA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. To Whom It May Concern certificate for UAE nationals. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: UAE nationals only, and only for a marriage, medical or study matter abroad
Applicant must be a UAE national
The application must be complete with all documents attached
documents: Marriage: applicant's passport copy and spouse's passport or ID copy
Medical: applicant and patient passport copies, sponsorship note, medical report attested by the UAE mission and MOFA abroad with certified translation
Study: applicant's passport copy, scholarship note and school letter attested by the UAE mission and MOFA abroad with certified translation
fees: AED 300 total for attestation by MOFA and the UAE mission
channels: MOFA website or UAE MoFA app, sign in with UAE PASS
Certificate is emailed to the address on UAE PASS
